title: FAQ
description: Six real objections answered in a native, exclusive accordion, beside a quiet offer to talk to a person.
summary: A two-column FAQ built on details/summary with no JavaScript.
notes: Questions open and close with native details and summary. The shared name attribute keeps one answer open at a time; browsers without exclusive-details support simply allow several open.
Answers are sample copy about a fictional product. Replace the hosting, billing and export claims with your own policies.
The walkthrough link is a placeholder fragment.
